label: INTERACTION_NATURALISM_4: InteractionNaturalism o P w:= ∀ x y, o.Causes w x y → P y → P x: whatever…
definition: `InteractionNaturalism o P w := ∀ x y, o.Causes w x y → P y → P x`: whatever causes something that satisfies P satisfies P.
note: Papineau's p.11 formulation with P = physical (claim PAPINEAU-RISE-INTERACTION-PHYSICAL). It speaks of exercised causation, N3 of causal power; neither entails the other without the exercise-to-power reading.
